## Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD status | Policy on PQ | Additional safety |
|---|---|---|
| **G6PD Normal** | PQ 0.25–0.5 mg/kg over 14 days | Not specified |
| **G6PD Intermediate** | Not specified | Not specified |
| **G6PD Deficient** | PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week over 8 weeks | With medical supervision and access to transfusion services |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg over 14 days based on risk-benefit assessment | With medical supervision and access to transfusion services |
